fields.description:
## Problem
`reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot` is the last reconciler write that composes `git_adapter.add` + `git_adapter.commit` against the tickets tracker OUTSIDE the atomic locked commit+push transaction. Ticket 6454-d06e-7361-4e3d attempted the conversion and reverted it: the only offered seam, `rebar._store.push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch`, stages with `git add -A`, which sweeps in `.bridge_state/last-pass.json` — a per-pass timestamp the deliberate selective 5-file staging excludes. The tickets HEAD then advances on every idempotent pass and `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py::test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head` goes RED (reproduced in CI on Gerrit 1821 ps1 and locally).

Ticket 638a-3746-e58a-4929's R3 composition gate therefore lands with a durable reasoned `# raw-git-ok:` marker on that site. This ticket removes the marker by removing the reason for it.

## Approach (decided)
Extract the locked commit phase of `commit_and_push_tickets_branch` (exclude-lock-artifacts, write_lock, rebase guard, status, stage, commit) into a shared helper that takes an optional `paths` pathspec (`None` = today's `git add -A`; a sequence = `git status/add -- <paths>` scoped staging), and export it as `commit_tickets_branch(tracker, *, message, paths=None, strict=False, author_name=None, author_email=None)` — commit under the shared write lock, NO push. `commit_and_push_tickets_branch` keeps its exact current behavior (locked `-A` commit, then delivery) by calling the same helper then `push_tickets_branch`.

`_commit_binding_store_snapshot` then calls `commit_tickets_branch(tracker_dir, message=..., paths=<the 5 existing .bridge_state files>, strict=True)` instead of composing `git_adapter.add` + `diff_cached_names` + `commit`.

Classifications, explicit:
- **Push is OUT of scope and behavior is preserved**: today's site does not push; the new `commit_tickets_branch` never pushes. No caller of `commit_and_push_tickets_branch` changes behavior (same staging, same lock, same delivery).
- **Fail-open contract preserved**: `strict=True` makes any seam failure (stage/commit/lock-timeout/rebase-guard) raise `PushDeliveryError`, which the site's existing broad `except Exception` already converts into `return False` + stderr log + dedup'd `bridge_alerts` append — the exact contract `reconcile.py` depends on. Success paths (commit made, or nothing-to-commit) return normally → `True`.
- **Per-file idempotency (bug 1e08) preserved**: the pathspec-scoped `git status --porcelain -- <paths>` reports a change in ANY of the 5 named files individually (a retirement-only `bindings-retired.json` change stages and commits; no change in any of the 5 → no commit, HEAD unmoved), which is the property the basename check implemented.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `_commit_binding_store_snapshot` no longer calls `git_adapter.add`/`git_adapter.commit`; it goes through the shared locked seam (`rebar._store.push.commit_tickets_branch`), which does NOT push (today's no-push behavior preserved).
- [ ] The committed file set is unchanged (the same 5 `.bridge_state` files, never `-A`): a dirty non-allowlisted tracker file (e.g. `.bridge_state/last-pass.json`) is not committed and does not advance HEAD on an otherwise-unchanged pass.
- [ ] The fail-open bool + alert contract is unchanged: seam failure → `False` + stderr + dedup'd bridge_alerts entry (existing tests in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_commit_binding_store_failure.py stay green); success and nothing-to-commit → `True`.
- [ ] `test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head` stays green, as do the retirement/rotation per-file idempotency tests (bug 1e08).
- [ ] The `raw-git-ok` marker on `reconcile_helpers.py` is deleted and `scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py` still passes.
- [ ] `commit_and_push_tickets_branch` callers see no behavior change (existing unit tests stay green).
